stories.summary: Add an OIDC authorization-code + PKCE login flow for the dashboard
stories.description: OIDC authenticates API clients only: the bundled dashboard mints no token, so under PIPELINE_IDENTITY_PROVIDER=oidc every /api/ call from the browser is a 401. A human cannot use the UI on a shared server.
stories.agent_instructions:
Preflight: impact run 2026-10-28 on master cd09a83 - a stand-in of LG-01..03 together (app/oidc_login.py with /auth/login, /auth/callback, /auth/logout mounted only when login is configured; the session-cookie fallback and cross-site write check in app/dashboard.py `_enforce_api_key`; the 401 redirect in static/app/api.js `fetchJson`): 17747 passed / 21 skipped, 0 conflicts, including the .mjs suites tests/unit/test_node_suites.py runs. Four other failures are environment-only and fail identically on untouched master in the planning container (test_aider_harness_availability x2: proxy-injected GH_TOKEN; test_docs_have_no_personal_home_path: the container HOME is the root user's home, which the guard bans by value; test_remote_sync ssh: no ssh binary).

TARGET IMPLEMENTER: cloud open-source (Claude-class sizing, every mechanically checkable requirement graded below). Provider/model are NOT pinned: dispatch resolves them from the live model registry's `roles.dispatch` entry.

SECURITY-SENSITIVE: request a security-engineer review in the PR (risk high routes it there).

WHAT TO BUILD (new module app/oidc_login.py; app/dashboard.py is 964 lines - add at most ~10 lines there to mount the routes):
1. Config: `PIPELINE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID`, `PIPELINE_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE` (path to a 0600 file; never the secret inline in env), `PIPELINE_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI`. All three set = login enabled; none = disabled (API-only, today's behavior); a partial set refuses to start, naming the missing variable.
2. `GET /auth/login`: discovery from the configured issuer (reuse app/oidc.py's address-checked fetch), generate `state`, `nonce`, PKCE `code_verifier` (S256), store them server-side keyed by state with a 10-minute TTL, redirect to the authorization endpoint.
3. `GET /auth/callback`: reject unknown/expired/reused state; exchange the code (client secret + verifier); verify the ID token with the EXISTING `OidcProvider` rules plus `nonce`; create a server-side session (256-bit random id) holding only the principal and expiry; set cookie `__Host-pipeline_session` (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/), idle timeout 30 min, absolute 8 h.
4. No token, code, verifier or secret is ever logged or returned in an error body.

TESTS (new tests/unit/test_oidc_login_flow.py, IdP mocked at the HTTP boundary): happy path sets the cookie; bad/expired/replayed state rejected; nonce mismatch rejected; token exchange failure -> generic error; partial config refuses startup; disabled config exposes no /auth routes.

stories.summary: Accept the login session in the dashboard auth middleware with CSRF protection
stories.description: Turn the session cookie into a Principal for /api/ requests, alongside bearer tokens, and protect cookie-authenticated writes from cross-site requests.
stories.agent_instructions:
Preflight: impact run 2026-10-28 on master cd09a83 - a stand-in of LG-01..03 together (app/oidc_login.py with /auth/login, /auth/callback, /auth/logout mounted only when login is configured; the session-cookie fallback and cross-site write check in app/dashboard.py `_enforce_api_key`; the 401 redirect in static/app/api.js `fetchJson`): 17747 passed / 21 skipped, 0 conflicts, including the .mjs suites tests/unit/test_node_suites.py runs. Four other failures are environment-only and fail identically on untouched master in the planning container (test_aider_harness_availability x2: proxy-injected GH_TOKEN; test_docs_have_no_personal_home_path: the container HOME is the root user's home, which the guard bans by value; test_remote_sync ssh: no ssh binary).

TARGET IMPLEMENTER: cloud open-source (Claude-class sizing, every mechanically checkable requirement graded below). Provider/model are NOT pinned: dispatch resolves them from the live model registry's `roles.dispatch` entry.

WHAT TO BUILD (session lookup in app/oidc_login.py; a small hook in the existing app/dashboard.py `/api/` middleware):
1. Under `PIPELINE_IDENTITY_PROVIDER=oidc`: a valid bearer token wins; otherwise a valid, unexpired session cookie yields its principal; otherwise 401 (unchanged).
2. CSRF for cookie-authenticated state-changing requests (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE): require `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin` or an `Origin` equal to the configured redirect URI's origin; otherwise 403. Bearer-authenticated requests are exempt (no ambient credential).
3. `POST /auth/logout`: deletes the server-side session and clears the cookie; if discovery advertises `end_session_endpoint`, return its URL for the UI to follow.

TESTS (new tests/unit/test_oidc_session_middleware.py): cookie principal reaches `request.state.principal` and the bound actor; expired/idle session -> 401; cross-site POST with cookie -> 403 and no mutation; same-origin POST allowed; bearer request unaffected; logout invalidates the session server-side (old cookie -> 401).

stories.summary: Send the dashboard UI through login on 401 and add a sign-out control
stories.description: Browser side of the login flow: a 401 from /api/ redirects to /auth/login; a sign-out control calls /auth/logout.
